question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1**
solution:
The correct answer is: **involved**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first sentence of the given passage is written in the **passive **form of the **simple present tense**.
 
• The structure follows: Object+ is/am/are+ V3+ by + subject__
 
• So, the **third **form of the verb should be used here.
 
• Hence, '**involved**' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **Involved **means being a part of something or being associated with it.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Complete passage: *All drivers are affected by road rage, whether they are directly or indirectly __**(1) involved**.__ Individual coping qualities (2)____________ the behaviour of stressful drivers. Instead of being enraged over circumstances beyond their control, drivers (3)__________ learn to be patient. On the road, we must be (4) __________ to control our own emotions. Road raged drivers are also more likely to (5) __________ more traffic offences.*
